environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB target group is configured with health checks on /api/v2/sync/health. The ALB security group allows inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No JEP-290 serialization filter is configured (jdk.serialFilter system property is unset). The application classpath includes commons-collections4-4.0.jar which contains known gadget chains. No WAF is attached to the ALB. Service mesh (Istio) is not deployed in this environment.
